info.name: VLTD - OEM Panel APIs
info.description:
APIs found while testing the OEM panel (Management > Device Management, User Management > Fitment Center / Staff, Dashboard, Command Center, Tracking and Alerts) plus the State Admin set-up calls they depend on.

HOW TO USE
1. Import this collection and the environment file.
2. Fill oem_email / oem_password (and admin_*, other_oem_*, fc_password if you use those folders) in the environment. Nothing secret is stored in the files.
3. Run '00 Authentication' first, then '01 Set-up' top to bottom; the later folders reuse the ids the scripts store.
4. Requests carry status checks. Those named after a bug (BUG-0xx) assert the CORRECT behaviour, so they fail while the bug is open.

Use throw-away data only. Fitment centres and OEM accounts cannot be deleted by the application; blacklisting is final.

item.name: 00 Authentication

request.description: Signs in as the OEM Admin. The access token is stored in the collection variable oem_token. Fill the e-mail / password variables in the environment first.

exec: (function () { try { var v = pm.response.json(); "data.access_token".split(".").forEach(function (k) { v = v[k]; }); if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("oem_token", String(v)); } catch (e) {} })();
